RESPONSIBILITY AND COMPLIANCE STATEMENT

Dataset: Station 14 surface temperature series, 2019-2023.
Depositor: Observatoire de Paris.

The dataset contains instrument readings only. It contains no personal data and
no information relating to identifiable individuals. There are no third-party
rights over the material. No ethics approval was required.

The data may be published openly under CC BY 4.0. Applicable jurisdiction: France.
